mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_node_execution (tenant_id, run_id, node_execution_id, node_id, execution_index, attempt, status, trace_id, started_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{nodeExecutionId}, #{nodeId}, #{executionIndex}, #{attempt}, #{status}, #{traceId}, #{startedAt})

INSERT INTO workflow_route_decision (tenant_id, run_id, route_decision_id, node_execution_id, source_node_id, target_node_id, edge_id, strategy, reason, terminal, trace_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{routeDecisionId}, #{nodeExecutionId}, #{sourceNodeId}, #{targetNodeId}, #{edgeId}, #{strategy}, #{reason}, #{terminal}, #{traceId})
